ai_summary: Here is an executive summary of the financial document:  20 Microns Limited reported a return to year-on-year revenue growth in Q2 FY27, driven by a strategic shift towards higher-value specialty mineral solutions and an ongoing ₹100 crore CapEx program focused on capacity expansion and captive resources. However, operating margins were materially impacted by significant increases in power, fuel, and export freight costs, leading to lower EBITDA and PAT compared to prior periods. The company is addressing these cost headwinds with new captive mines and a 9 MW solar plant expected to yield an ₹8 crore annual EBITDA benefit from FY29, alongside continued innovation in advanced materials for future growth.
